step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a multi-tenant application on AWS EKS interacting with Amazon Aurora. A single-tenant customer AWS account created by AWS Control Tower contains Amazon QuickSight and an AWS VPN connection. QuickSight connects to Aurora via AWS Transit Gateway and ingests external customer data from On-Premises via VPN.

graph.name: Summit Technology Group - Single Tenant Data Consumption Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for single-tenant data consumption using EKS, Aurora, Transit Gateway, Control Tower, QuickSight, and VPN to connect on-premises customer data.

edges.notes: EKS pods write and read loan data to/from Aurora.
